title: Checking
description: Running the checks and reporting what they find: each check is a rule with its own query, a problem names its check and its record, and an error means the data is broken while a warning is work still to do. What the schema enforces never reaches a check: Lathe refuses it, and data it refuses is one data-refused error per refusal. A product adds checks of its own. Checking also keeps the checks the schema cannot hold: records that nothing uses, the shape warnings (a test at a level its kind does not allow, an event not delivered by outbox), and levels of the spec that are the wrong size. Every problem shows in the Checks view and the Dock badge.

title: Exploring
description: Reading a product: its pages at their addresses, the Graph, ERD and Trace stages with the wiki card, the nav and its stage folders, quick find, spaces, and places in tabs. The pages read the product's data, and a record's page also changes it: an edit, a new child or a removal is one command of the record's aggregate, as an Agent's writes are, and every change lands in the data files for review in git.

title: Interaction design
description: Where a flow happens: views with their requirements, endpoints with their API requirements, the integrations a product exchanges with, and the UI components that draw the views.
notes: The checks that hold its records to these rules are designed here, beside the rules; Checking runs them and reports what they find.

title: Domain modeling
description: Each domain's model, by business capability: domains with their capabilities, terms, services and repositories; aggregates with their entities and invariants; commands, domain events, value objects, specifications, and read models with their queries; and what each aggregate or read model must keep, its storage requirements.
notes: The checks that hold its records to these rules are designed here, beside the rules; Checking runs them and reports what they find.

title: Platform
description: What every slice stands on: the app shell and workbench with its panels, commands and keys, themes, the workspace loaded from the data files and reloaded live, the command runner every aggregate's command goes through, the server and its transport, and the desktop shell, a window per product folder around the same app. Platform follows the two app patterns, App code (LA-PAT-APP-CODE) and App experience (LA-PAT-APP-UX), and holds the standards, stability, accessibility and performance suites that prove them for the whole app.
notes: The desktop app runs three ways: `npm --prefix desktop run dev` for development, which loads the owner's dev server on port 5199 when it serves the opened folder or else one of its own; `npm --prefix desktop start`, which builds Lathe and runs the shell as it ships; and `npm --prefix desktop run pack`, an unsigned macOS app for this Mac. Signed builds, notarizing, auto-update and Windows and Linux builds come later and need the owner's approval to publish.

title: Product
description: What a product is for and how it is written down in Lathe's one language: its business outcomes and the journeys that reach them, its roles, interfaces and open questions; the stages and order of kinds and the reference that shows them; the kinds and relations a product declares as its own, and their records; merging two branches' data; and the rules every record keeps: an ID of its own under one parent, links as the only relations, one line of its data file.
notes: The checks that hold its records to these rules are designed here, beside the rules; Checking runs them and reports what they find.

title: Technical specification
description: How the design is built: the standards its code follows, tables with their keys, entry points, tooling, and the data stores where its data lives.
notes: The checks that hold its records to these rules are designed here, beside the rules; Checking runs them and reports what they find.

title: Traceability
description: Following what designs, builds and proves each obligation, and counting it: coverage per domain and obligation kind, designed through flow steps and the technical records that implement each design, built through their files and proved through the tests under each obligation; the gaps, each domain's tests by state, the pattern rules each domain owes, and each record's traceability. The engine counts it, and Lathe shows it with the product, with each domain and in each record's Traceability section.

title: Test planning
description: The tests that prove each record: the test of its kind for each obligation, how it runs, and the test data sets tests start from.
notes: The checks that hold its records to these rules are designed here, beside the rules; Checking runs them and reports what they find.

title: Use cases
description: Use cases with their actors, requirements, flows and tests, and the patterns several of them share, written once with their rules, settings and slots.
notes: The checks that hold its records to these rules are designed here, beside the rules; Checking runs them and reports what they find.
